name: Konstantin Nikolaev
current_role: Private investor; owner of La Madonnina winery (Bolgheri, Tuscany); former co-owner of Globaltrans/N-Trans and Global Ports
profile: Russian-born logistics entrepreneur (b. 1971, Dnipropetrovsk) who co-founded Severstaltrans in 1996 with Nikita Mishin, Andrei Filatov and Alexei Mordashov, later N-Trans, which grew into Globaltrans (Russia's largest private rail operator) and Global Ports. He sold out of the ports in 2017 and completed his exit from all Russian business in January 2024; the Tuscan winery is now his main focus.
interesting_fact: He is one of the co-founders of the Moscow School of Management Skolkovo, described as Russia's first business school; he also was an early investor in US-based American Ethane.
deep_cut_fact: He studied philosophy at Moscow State University and wrote his thesis on Plato's Republic, then started his logistics career as a forwarding agent at Murmansk port coordinating ship loading.
notes: Sensitive profile: under Ukrainian sanctions (2023) and has had press coverage tied to US politics; avoid those topics. Citizen of Malta per Wikipedia. No published personal/office contact found; any approach would likely be via the La Madonnina winery or a lawyer/spokesperson.

name: Sergey Kasyanenko
current_role: Co-founder and Chairman of the Management Board, Orimi Group (Russia)
profile: Co-founder of Orimi, Russia's largest producer of tea and roasted coffee (brands Greenfield, TESS, Jardin, Princess Noori). Orimi started in 1994 as Orimi Trade, a wholesaler of flour, sugar and tea, then built its own packaging and coffee plants in Leningrad Region. Most of his fortune is cash from roughly $1.5bn of Orimi dividends.
interesting_fact: He holds a Ph.D. in physics and mathematics before becoming a tea and coffee magnate.
deep_cut_fact: Orimi's very first tea brand, launched at its founding in 1994, was 'Princess Kandy'; within two years Orimi Trade was one of Russia's six biggest tea importers. He and co-founder Alexander Evnevich personally opened Orimi's instant-coffee plant with the Leningrad Region governor.
notes: Very low public profile; little English-language coverage. Company press office is the only published route.

name: Song Weiping
current_role: Founder of Greentown China; controls Bluetown (Lancheng) town-development / construction-management business
profile: Song Weiping (b. 1957, Sheng County, Shaoxing) is a Hangzhou property developer who founded Greentown China with his wife Xia Yibo in 1994, building it into a premium developer in Zhejiang, Shanghai and Beijing. He resigned as Greentown co-chairman in 2019 to focus on Bluetown and 'ideal town' projects.
interesting_fact: He founded the Zhejiang Greentown football club (Hangzhou Greentown F.C.) and is a well-known football fan.
deep_cut_fact: A 1982 history graduate of Hangzhou University, he taught at a party school for five years, then worked as a secretary at a computer company in Zhuhai before returning to Hangzhou and founding Greentown with RMB150,000.
notes: Fortune shared with wife Xia Yibo. Current Bluetown title not confirmed for 2025-26. No personal published contacts; route would be via Greentown China or Bluetown corporate offices.
